protocol.rows: v2's 16 development rows (8 poses x H10/H50, seeds 200-207), verbatim
protocol.same_wave: each run is ONE Slurm array of 32 tasks in which even indices run the baseline and odd the candidate on the same row, throttled at 8 concurrent; r1 and r2 are submitted by the same driver tick (v5's protocol)

improvement_rule.h10: pooled candidate H10 (16) vs pooled baseline H10 (16): margin >= 4 AND one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05
improvement_rule.h50: pooled candidate H50 (16) >= pooled baseline H50 (16), both measured in this campaign (non-regression)
improvement_rule.retention_guard: heldout_gate of the selected checkpoint from this campaign's training
improvement_rule.reload: this campaign's audit/reload_<label>.json: finite and config_matches_baseline
improvement_rule.all_rows_valid: every one of the 64 development episodes completed as a valid rollout

protocol.n_is_fixed: two runs per policy per horizon, whatever they show; no third run, no second attempt
protocol.final_set: used only as the confirmatory gate (confirmatory_gate / final_confirm); the 8-row descriptive final_test run is not executed in v8
protocol.baseline_numbers_from_earlier_campaigns: not pooled in; v8's own baseline runs (r1, r2, c1) are the only baseline
protocol.screen: the v5 rule on the 16 development rows, 2 runs per policy: a SCREEN only
protocol.confirmatory_gate: only if the screen passes: the 8 untouched final-set poses (Seen_1/2, mesh PS_049, 7 of 8 poses absent from dev and every search) x H10/H50 x 3 distinct seeds per policy in ONE interleaved array (96 episodes); a positive claim needs the same rule on 24 vs 24 (H10 margin >= 4 and one-sided Fisher p < 0.05, H50 non-regression, all rows valid); spent once
protocol.confirmatory_power: stated in advance: realistically low (the v7 diagnosis estimates at most ~27% given candidates' 0/16 on PS_049 dev rows at H10)
protocol.reported_not_gated: post hoc, written after three candidates lost P_B H50: whether P_B H50 reaches >= 2/4 and whether any H50 row the baseline settles in both runs drops to 0/2; reach counted from the per-step geometric trace
